changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Record a publish intent as the single append-only event that atomically advances a BUILT candidate into QUALITY_RUNNING.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate_command DROP CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_command_payload;
ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate_command ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_command_payload CHECK ( candidate_version > 0 AND event_type IN ( 'CREATED', 'SCOPE_REPLACED', 'STATUS_CHANGED', 'PUBLICATION_REQUESTED', 'STALE_DETECTED' ) AND to_status IN ( 'DRAFT', 'BUILDING', 'BUILD_FAILED', 'BUILT', 'QUALITY_RUNNING', 'QUALITY_FAILED', 'QUALITY_PASSED', 'REVIEW_PENDING', 'REJECTED', 'APPROVED', 'PUBLISHING', 'PARTIAL', 'PUBLISHED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'CANCELLED', 'STALE' ) AND ( from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ( 'DRAFT', 'BUILDING', 'BUILD_FAILED', 'BUILT', 'QUALITY_RUNNING', 'QUALITY_FAILED', 'QUALITY_PASSED', 'REVIEW_PENDING', 'REJECTED', 'APPROVED', 'PUBLISHING', 'PARTIAL', 'PUBLISHED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'CANCELLED', 'STALE' ) ) AND ((event_type = 'CREATED' AND from_status IS NULL) OR (event_type <> 'CREATED' AND from_status IS NOT NULL)) AND ( event_type <> 'PUBLICATION_REQUESTED' OR (from_status = 'BUILT' AND to_status = 'QUALITY_RUNNING') ) AND btrim(actor_id) <> '' AND actor_id = btrim(actor_id) AND btrim(reason) <> '' AND octet_length(reason) <= 4096 AND btrim(idempotency_key) <> '' AND idempotency_key = btrim(idempotency_key) AND request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof(response_snapshot) = 'object' AND octet_length(response_snapshot::text) <= 1048576 );
